Yisiphi isifundo esingasifunda ngesitebhisi esabonwa uJakobe ehlane-na? Genesis 28:16, 17;
Chaza ukuxhumana okwamiswa ukulamula kukaKristu.

lessons.title: Ukuphenduka
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngalokhu phendukani, niguquke ukuba kuhlangulwe izono zenu”

questions.text: Yibuphi ubufakazi bokuphenduka kweqiniso okwafunwa nguJohane uMbhapathizi-na?
Kuyini okufanele sikwazi ngokuphenduka kweqiniso okuguqula inhliziyo nokuphila-na?
Kuncenga kuni uDavide akwenza lapho ebona ukusinda kwesono sakhe-na?
Ukuphenduka kweqiniso kukaDavide kwamholela ukuba afuneni-na?
Kuyini iBhayibheli elikufundisayo ngokuphenduka nokuzinikela ngokuphelele kuKristu-na?
Yabanjani imvelo yokuphenduka kukaEsawu, kaFaro noJudasi lapho bebona imiphumela yesono sabo-na?
Kuyini okwenzakalayo lapho isoni singaphenduki futhi silibazisa ukuphenduka kwaso kuze kube isikhathi esizayo-na?
Uyini umehluko phakathi koMfarisi nomthelisi embalini kaKristu-na?
Kuyini uJesu akusho ngomphumela womkhuleko womthelisi-na?
Ekuxoxeni lendaba, yisiphi isimo sengqondo esilimazayo uJesu ayefuna ukusilungisa-na?
Iyiphi ingozi yokunganaki ukuvuma noma ukulibazisa ukuphendula-na?
Kuyini okufanele sikwenze lapho sibona ukuthi inhliziyo nokuphila kwethu akuvumelani noNkulunkulu-na?

lessons.title: Ukuvuma Izono
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ofihla iziphambeko zakhe akayikuphumelela, kodwa ozivumayo azishiye uyakuthola umusa”

questions.text: Lapho silahlwa ngesono, kuyini okufanele sikwenze-na?
Ngenxa yalesimo kuyini okudingeka kithi-na?
Uma sithe sazwisa omunye ubuhlungu, yimuphi omunye esimkhubekisayo-na?
Kungani kufanele sithethelele abanye-na?
Kuyini okufanele kusifundise umsebenzi wethu maqondana nomuntu-na? 1 Peter 4:8;
Yiziphi izono okumele zivunywe obala kuyilapho ezinye zivunywa kuNkulunkulu kuphela-na?
Ngeyiphi inhloso yokuvuma izono ngeqiniso-na?
Yisiphi isenzo esisebenzayo okufanele silandele ukuvuma izono-na?
Lapho uNkulunkulu ebuza uAdamu noEva ngesono sabo, kungayiphi indlela abasho ngayo ukuthi akulona iphutha labo ngempela-na? Genesis 3:12, 13.
Kungani ukuzithethelela kwenza ukuvuma izono kungaphumeleli-na?
Kungayiphi indlela uPawule ngokuthobeka avuma ngokuqondile isono sakhe-na?
Kuyini uPawule ayimemezela encwadini yakhe yokuqala ku-Thimothi-na?
Uma sizivuma izono zethu, kuyini lokhu uNkulunkulu akuthembisile-na?

lessons.title: Ukungcweliswa
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Niyakungifuna, ningifumane; lapho ningifunisisa ngenhliziyo yenu yonke”

questions.text: UPawule uchaza kanjani impi yobuKrestu nezikhali ezidingekayo-na?
Kukuphi lapho uSathane ezama ukuthola umbuso ngokuphelele-na?
Kuyini okumele ukudele ukuze ube-ngumfundi kaKristu-na?
Siyini isimemo iNkosi esidlulisela kubo bonke abafisa ukuvuselelwa kwenhliziyo nokuphila-na?
Kuyini okunikeza uKristu ilungelo lokuthathela abantwana Bakhe abayise ezulwini-na?
Kuyini uJesu akufuna kubo bonke abafisa ukuba abantwana Bakhe nabadinga ulwazi lokwamukela uMoya Wakhe-na?
Yisiphi isifiso sikaPawule esiqotho samakholwa-na?
Lapho izixuku zizwa inkulumo kaPeter ngosuku lwePentekoste, wawuyini umthwalo wezinhliziyo zabo-na?
Kuyini okuletha ukuqiniseka kokuthi singangcweliswa ngokungcwele eNkosini futhi sikwazi ukuthwala umfanekiso kaKristu-na?
Kungagcinwa kanjani ukuqina ekukholweni nokuzinikela ngokuphelele ezimisweni ezifanele ukugcinwa-na?

lessons.title: Ukukholwa Nokwamukela
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngiyakuninika inhliziyo entsha, ngifake phakathi kwenu umoya omusha, ngikhiphe inhliziyo yetshe enyameni yenu, ngininike inhliziyo yenyama”

questions.text: Yisiphi isithembiso sikaNkulunkulu esimangalisayo sentethelelo nokuthula-na?
Yisiphi esinye isithembiso esibalulekile esizoguqula sonke isidalwa sibe umuntu omusha ngokuvumelana noNkulunkulu-na?
Kuyini uJesu akutshela ofe uhlangothi eBethesda ukuba akwenze futhi kuyini esingakufunda kulamava-na?
Kuyini okuthenjiswe isoni ngoKristu-na?
Uma uJesu emukelwa njengoMsindisi, kwenzekani ezonweni zesikhathi esedlule-na?
Ukuma okunjani okholwayo anakho phambi kukaNkulunkulu-na?
Ngeyiphi inguquko okumele ibonwe yibo bonke abangena ebudlelwaneni besivumelwano noNkulunkulu-na? 1 Peter 1:18, 19;
Kungayiphi indlela okulindelwe ukuthi ikholwa liziphathe ngayo-na?
Yikuphi ukuhlinzekelwa kwamaphutha okwenziwe ngohlelo lokufunda-na?
Chaza ukuthi siqiniswa kanjani kuloluhambo.
Yiziphi izimo zokwamukelwa nguNkulunkulu-na?
Siyini isimo sengqondo kaBaba wethu osezulwini seqiniso kubo bonke abadukile-na?

lessons.title: Ukuhlolwa Kobufundi
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kanjalo uma umuntu ekuKristu, uyisidalwa esisha; okwakuqala kudlulile; bheka, sekuvele okusha”

questions.text: Yisiphi isifundo uKristu asifundisa sona lapho echaza umsebenzi wokuphenduka-na?
Ngeyiphi inguquko ezobonakala ekuphileni kulowo oguquke ngempela-na?
Yisiphi isithelo esivezwa yilabo abangcweliswe ngoMoya-na?
Buyini ubufakazi bokuphenduka kwangempela-na?
Yimaphi amaphutha emukelekayo kumaKrestu azishoyo-na? Filiphi 3:9;
Kungayiphi indlela isithembiso sesivumelwano esisha senza kugqame kanjani ukuthi umusa kaKristu awusikhiphi ekulaleleni umthetho kaNkulunkulu-na?
Kuyini okulindelwe kumalunga azokhethelwa ukuphila okuphakade-na?
Noma iNkosi yenzile amalungiselelo abo bonke ukuba bazuze insindiso, kungani abanye belahlekelwa indlela-na?
Kungayiphi indlela umpostoli uPawule aphila ngokunqoba-na?
Yinjabulo engakanani uMhlabeleli ayigcizelela ekuphileni kwakhe-na?

lessons.title: Ukukhula KuKristu
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngenze ukuba abalilayo eSiyoni baphiwe amaqhele esikhundleni somlotha, amafutha enjabulo esikhundleni sokulila, ingubo yokudumisa esikhundleni somoya odangeleyo, ukuze babizwe ngokuthi imithi yokulunga nokutshaliwe nguJehova ukuba adunyiswe”

questions.text: Kungayiphi indlela uMbhalo ufanekisa ukuthuthuka koMkrestu-na?
Kuyini okufanekiswa nokweyama kwethu kuKristu ukuze sikhule futhi sithuthuke-na?
Uyini umcijo obalulekile iNkosi yethu eyawugcizelela kubafundi Bakhe ngaphambi kokuqeda umsebenzi Wakhe emhlabeni-na?
Iyini imfihlo yokukhula koMkrestu-na?
Yimuphi umsebenzi wokuqala wabantwana bakaNkulunkulu njengoba beqala usuku ngalunye-na?
Yisiphi isimemo uKristu asinikeza nsuku zonke-na?
Siyini isihluthulelo sokuthola amava okuthula kwengqondo-na?
Uyini umphumela wokuvumela ingqondo ihlale kuJesu esikhundleni sokubheka umina-na?
Kuyini esingayifunda ekuguqukeni okwafikela abafundi emva kokuba benoKristu emsebenzini wokuvangela nsuku zonke-na?
Yisiphi isithembiso esimangalisayo uJesu asishiyela abalandeli Bakhe ababhekene nezinselelo zomhlaba olwayo-na?
Yimuphi umyalo obalulekile uJesu awushiyela abafundi Bakhe ukuze bazi ukuthi kuyini okumele bakwenze ngesikhathi sokuswela-na?

lessons.title: Umsebenzi Nokuphila
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha bonke abamamukelayo wabapha amandla okuba babe-ngabantwana bakaNkulunkulu, labo abakholwa egameni Lakhe”

questions.text: Kuyini okunganakwa yinhliziyo yemvelo-futhi ngamuphi umphumela-na?
Lapho uthando lukaKristu lulondozwa enhliziyweni, kuyini okuzobonakala ekuphileni-na?
Uma samukela uJesu njengoMsindisi wethu, yisiphi Isidingo esinikezwayo-na?
Uma sibhekene nezinkinga nobunzima, yisiphi iseluleko sompostoli uPawule-na?
Lapho siphenduka umntwana kaNkulunkulu, kuyini esikukweleta abanye-na?
Uma uMoya Ongcwele usenhliziyweni yethu, zizoba yini izenzo zethu zokuqala-na?
Yisiphi isibonelo sikaKristu okufanele sisiqondise ebudllelwaneni bethu nezihlobo kanye nomakhelwane-na?
Yisho ingozi eyodwa enkulu kithina njengamalunga ebandla namuhla.
Yiziphi izimfanelo ezinhle zobuKrestu ezisiza amakholwa akhule emseni naselwazini lweNkosi uJesu Kristu-na? 1 Peter 4:8-10;
Yisiphi isidingo okufanele sigcwaliswe amakholwa namuhla-na?
Kuyini okulindeleke kubo bonke abaphathiswe iVangeli-ikakukhulukazi izisebenzi-na?
Isiphi isibonelo uDaniyeli asibekele abasha namuhla-na?

lessons.title: Ulwazi NgoNkulunkulu
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ohlakaniphileyo makaqaphele lokhu; bayakuqonda umusa kaJehova”

questions.text: Yiziphi izinto kulomhlaba iNkosi efuna ukudonsela abantu Kuyo-na?
Kuyini uJesu akusebenzisa ukugxilisa iqiniso ezingqondweni zabalaleli Bakhe-na?
Yisiphi isifundo esingafundwa kwimvelo-ngesibonelo sezimbali, esezinyoni, kanye nezinkanyezi-na?
Uma sicabanga ngobuhle nokuthula kwemvelo engangcoliswanga, kuyini okufanele kukhumjulwe ngomhlaba omusha othenjisiwe-na?
Yiziphi izifundo eziyigugu ezingafundwa kubaprofethi ukuze zisikhuthaze ezikhathini zokudangala kanye nokulingwa-na?
Uma uNkulunkulu enakekela okwemvelo, kakhulu kangakanani kubantwana Bakhe-na?
Kukuphi lapho isithembiso sokunakekela kukaNkulunkulu okufanele sisiholele ekugxileni kukho-na?
Kukuphil lapho uKristu ebeka khona izambulo ezicacile zecebo likaNkulunkulu lokusindisa abantu-na?
Kuyini okufanele kwenziwa nsuku zonke yibo bonke abafisa ukukhula ekuqineni nasemandleni kaNkulunkulu-na?
Kungayiphi indlela okumele samukele ngayo izwi likaNkulunkulu ezinhliziyweni zethu-na?
Kuyini okwaletha induduzo nosizo kuJeremiya ngesikhathi sosizi lwakhe-na?
Kungayiphi indlela iMibhalo kufanele ihlolwe ngayo nokuthi kuyini okumele kwandulele ukuhlola iBhaybheli-na?

lessons.title: Ilungelo Lomkhuleko
lessons.introduction: “IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha wena, nxa ukhuleka, ngena ekamelweni lakho, uthi usuvale umnyango wakho ukhuleke kuYihlo osekusithekeni; noyihlo obona ekusithekeni uzakukuvuza”

questions.text: Njenge-Ndodana yomuntu, kuyini uJesu akubona kudingekile-na?
Ngeyiphi indlela kaKristu yokukhuleka eyisibonelo kithi-na? Marako 1:35;
UJesu wabafundisa kanjani abafundi Bakhe ukukhuleka-na?
IBhayibheli likuchaza kanjani ukuzinikela kukaKristu, nesizathu sokuthi lokhu kwakubaluleke kangaka-na?
UJesu wasembulela kanjani isimo sengqondo kaYise ngesidingo somuntu-na?
Kuyini okuvimba izicelo zethu ukuba zizwakale eNkosini-na?
Yiziphi izimpawu ezibalulekile zomkhuleko ophumelelayo uma ziqhathaniswa nomkhuleko obuthakathaka nongasizi ngalutho-na?
Ukuze umkhuleko uzwakale eNkosini, yisiphi isimoya okufanele sibenaso-na?
Kuyini esingakufunda kumkhuleko kaEliya ekhulekela imvula-na?
Myalo muni obalulekile abapostoli abawunikezayo maqondana nomkhuleko-na? 1 Peter 4:7;
Njengomzali ngamunye, kuyini iNkosi ekulindele kubantwana ukuba bakwenze-na?

lessons.title: Kuyini Esingakwenza Ngokungabaza
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha makacele ngokukholwa engangabazi ngalutho; ngokuba ongabazayo unjengedlambi lolwandle eliqhutshwa, ligujiswa ngumoya”

questions.text: Kuyini okufanele sikukhumbule lapho silingeka ukuntengantenga phakathi kokukholwa nokungabaza-na?
Kuyini iNkosi esinikeze kona ukuze sinqobe ukungabaza-na?
Kufanele siqonde kanjani izimfihlakalo uNkulunkulu angazange asichazele zona-na?
Kuyini okubhekwa eBhayibhelini ukuthi kunezinto okunzima ukuziqonda-na? 2 Peter 3:16.
Ngeyiphi ingozi ekhethekile kumakholwa alezinsuku zokugcina-na?
Kuyini okuprofethiwe ngesimo samaxuku amambili ezinsukwini zokugcina-na?
Singahlukanisa kanjani phakathi kokubalulekile nokuyize-na?
Yiziphi izibusiso eziyotholwa abathobekile-na?
Umpostoli uPawule uchaza kanjani amava okholwayo namuhla nawesikhathi esizayo-na?
Iyiphi indlela ephawulekayo iNkosi eyembula izwi layo namuhla njengoba ukuphela kusondela-na?
Kuyini amakholwa okufanele akwenze ekuhloleni iMibhalo-na?

lessons.title: Ukuthokoza ENkosini
lessons.introduction: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha njengalokhu ningabahlanganyeli bezinhlupheko zikaKristu, thokozani, ukuze kuthi nasekwambulweni kwenkazimulo yakhe nithokoze, nethabe nokwethaba”

questions.text: Kuziphendulela kuni uJesu akusho kubafundi Bakhe abanakho kulomhlaba-na?
Kuyini abakholwayo okufanele babeyikho ebantwini bonke-na?
Kungenzeka kanjani ukuphelelisa lomsebenzi-na?
Yikuphi ukubonakaliswa okuphakeme kakhulu kothando lukaNkulunkulu kubantwana Bakhe-na?
Kuyini okufakazele ukuthi uNkulunkulu uthanda ukunika abantwana Bakhe zonke izinto-na?
Loluthando kufanele lubonakaliswe kanjani kithi-na?
Kuyini okwabonakala ekuphileni kukaKristu emsebenzini Wakhe wokusindisa abantu-na?
Ekuhluphekeni Kwakhe nasekulingweni, kuyini okwanikeza uJesu isibindi sokuphelelisa umsebenzi Wakhe-na?
Lapho isilingo sibhekene nokholwayo, kuyini okwanikeza ukuze anqobe lempi yesimoya-na?
Kungani abaningi bengabaza phakathi kokukholwa nokungabaza lapho belingwa noma bevivinywa-na? Kufanele benzeni-na?
Injani indlela yabalungileyo naphakathi kwesilingo-na?
Yisiphi isithembiso sikaJesu okufanele sisinikeze isizathu sokujabula nokudumisa uBaba wethu osezulwini-na?
Yisho ezinye izithembiso ezimangalisayo zokuthula nenjabulo uJesu azinikezayo.
